ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixels and 15% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the lateral lobe extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs located on the distal ends of both lobes. The left lobe exhibits a concentrated white patch on the outer 20% of the fluke surface; the right lobe displays fragmented white mottling near the apex.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 48 degrees and a narrow vertex depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged serrations visible along the entire trailing boundary; the left lobe shows high-amplitude peaks (3-5 pixels depth), while the right lobe displays higher frequency, low-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, upward-curving points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) concentrated on the extreme tips of both lobes, particularly prominent on the right distal edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear white streaks (rake marks) visible on the dark pigmented area of the mid-right lobe, traversing diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization and associated scarring on the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
